installCommand: echo 'Dependencies will be managed by uv during build'
buildCommand: uv run --no-project --with-requirements requirements.txt python -m py_compile configuracoes.py ambiente.py organismos.py quadtree.py mundo.py main.py && uv run --no-project --with-requirements requirements.txt python -c "from mundo import Mundo; mundo = Mundo(); mundo.atualizar(); print(mundo.obter_estatisticas())" && uv run --no-project --with-requirements requirements.txt python -m pygbag --build --ume_block 0 .
